clips.title: The story
paras: A Scribbled Letter is a summons delivered to adventurers at Northshire Abbey following their early clashes with nearby kobolds. Sent under the seal of Tordrin Stemblade, it directs promising recruits to seek out his training and guidance. The letter marks a crucial step in preparing defenders to face the escalating perils threatening the kingdom of Stormwind.

Upon returning from skirmishes with the kobold camps infesting the valley, adventurers at Northshire Abbey receive a hasty missive. Marked with the seal of Tordrin Stemblade, the note requests their prompt attention before attending to other business. The letter serves as an urgent summons to connect budding champions with formal mentorship within the abbey's protective grounds.

When presented with the letter, Tordrin Stemblade remarks on how times have changed, observing how unfamiliar folk have taken up weapons in defense of the realm. Acknowledging that the surrounding wilderness grows more hazardous by the day, he invites travelers to seek out his counsel day or night as they master their skills and assist the beleaguered people of Stormwind.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, friend. It appears to be a letter sealed with the mark of Tordrin Stemblade, our local adventurer trainer. Take a moment to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, ye got me letter, friend... Good.
Time was when ye'd not catch a traveler dead wit' a bow in their hand--no more, I guess. It's good for Stormwind, but bad for the kobolds and man eatin' beasts in the area.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Get yerself squared away, learn the lay o' the land, and come back to me whenever you need training. I'll be here night or day.
This land is grown' more dangerous, and as ye meet other folk, I think ye'll find they all have problems they could use some help with--help a skilled adventurer can give 'em. Good luck.
